items.why: A power strip with plugs at the bottom of a dark bay, partly behind cables; the dark area reads as empty.
A patch panel full of blue cables, but its polygon is a thin slanted sliver: the straightened cut shows only cables, which look like a cable bundle in an empty gap.
A small dark vented storage front, tiny in the photo.
A black vented router chassis with two cables across it. The plain vented front looks like a blanking panel.
A tiny, very dark 1U server in a dark photo; very few pixels to judge from.
The polygon was drawn as a thin slanted sliver across the server, not around it, so the cut the model sees is a dark strip with almost nothing of the server's front.
A vented blanking panel between two devices.
